summary: A table of records the reader compares by property and opens one of.
not_for: Records the reader finds by name alone (collection.row.resource), or one record's fields (record.summary-list).

rules.rule: The first column is the record's human-readable name, a link to its single view when one exists.
One kind of value per column, and the header names exactly that.
Numbers align to the end and use tabular figures.
An empty cell stays blank: no dash, cross or emoji. A field that cannot take a value is the exception.
At most three row actions as buttons; the rest go in a menu.
The table's title does not repeat the page heading.
Past fifty rows the table pages.
The status column is headed ステータス, or 〇〇状況 when there are several; never 状況 or 状態 alone.

labels.empty_filtered: 該当する{object}はありません。

evidence.says: An index table lists objects with their properties in columns; numbers align right; past 50 rows it paginates.
Each column holds one data type; the header describes exactly that; empty cells stay blank; the table title does not repeat the page title.

evidence.source: SmartHR Design System, よくあるテーブル
evidence.says: The object name comes first; table actions number three at most; status is headed ステータス, 〇〇状況 when several, never 状況 or 状態 alone.
Headers are one or two words in sentence case; under three row actions sit inline as icons.
The first column is a human-readable record identifier; related columns sit next to each other.
